meta.title: Industries — thirteen sectors, thirteen different problems | Metal Form
meta.description: Medical, beverage and PET, automotive, cosmetics, appliances, chemical, electrical, consumer goods, agriculture, plumbing, furniture, marine and custom projects. Tooling, engineering, production and supply, written for each sector.

headline: Thirteen sectors.
Thirteen different
definitions of expensive.
hero.lead: A bottler measures cost in grams of resin. An irrigation manufacturer measures it in cavities. A heavy-vehicle buyer measures it in the years a tool has to last. The engineering is shared; almost nothing else is.

note: Each page is written for its own sector — its components, its failure modes, its economics and its vocabulary. If none of them is yours, the last one is.
